scope: targeted synthetic counterexamples, not field accuracy

flags.note: Target-minus-peer pressure shifts +7.0 hPa against a larger coherent reference group and ends at a corroborated return to the prior residual; exclude without assuming an exact calibration offset.
Wind ratio changes by factor 0.32 against a larger coherent reference group and a supported return closes the interval; exclude pending instrument/configuration verification.
Temperature residual jumps +30.0 C for 120 minutes then returns within 3 C of its prior peer-relative level, with clean three-hour context on both sides; exclude this bounded excursion.

unresolved_checks.reason: equally supported reference groups; trusted anchor required

evidence.climate_policy: Do not assign a failed group or treat this as validated data; seek an independent reference before using cross-boundary changes.
